product: Logitech G keyboards (HID++ 2.0, cable, Lightspeed receiver or Bluetooth)
works: written from Solaar (e7304c4c) and libratbag (8235b5bb) and checked against simulated keyboards only (tests/sim-logitech-keyboard.mjs)
feature lookup through Root getFeature (no fixed indexes); receivers: slots 1-6 pinged, a mouse (0x2201) is refused
report rate: 0x8061 or 0x8060, from the keyboard's own list (Solaar ExtendedReportRate / ReportRate), host mode only
settings source onboard / host: 0x8100 fn 0x20 / 0x10 (Solaar OnboardProfiles)

onboard profile: shown only (count from 0x8100 fn 0x00 byte 3, libratbag; active sector from fn 0x40, Solaar). Selecting one (fn 0x30) is switched off until the numbering is confirmed on a real keyboard; profiles are never edited
key locks, the Windows-key lock first: 0x4521 caps fn 0x00, read 0x10, write 0x20, the other bits sent back as read (Solaar DisableKeyboardKeys)
F-key swap: 0x40A2 or 0x40A0, read 0x00 / write 0x10 (Solaar NewFnSwap / FnSwap)
backlight brightness: 0x8040 info 0x00, read 0x10 / write 0x20, on/off 0x30 / 0x40, the keyboard's own steps when it has them (Solaar BrightnessControl)
every write read back; every write refused while G HUB (lghub*.exe) runs

Bluetooth: the G915 TKL on its Bluetooth id B35F (Linux hid-logitech-hidpp.c @ 3fabd8ec; inside Solaar base.py Bluetooth keyboard range 0xB317-0xB3FF), HID++ 2.0 at device index 0xFF, replies with index 0x00 taken (Solaar base.py), the collection with 19-byte input and output reports on any usage page (Solaar hidapi_impl.py / OpenRGB 0xFF43 and 0xFF00); the same battery, settings source, profile display, key locks, F-key swap and backlight
receivers C541 and C547 (G915, OpenRGB LogitechControllerDetect.cpp) and C545 (G915 TKL)

22 Oct 2026: on a receiver every slot 1-6 is asked read-only (ping, getFeature 0x2201, DEVICE_NAME 0x0005 fn 0x20 for the kind, Solaar hidpp20.py get_kind) and only a keyboard's slot is run; a mouse there is left to the mouse driver with no error, nothing answering is the normal asleep state, one driver per slot
doesNotWork: firmware updates, DFU, resets and pairing (never: Logitech's own app only)
editing onboard profiles (keys, macros, lights): profile memory writes rewrite flash and are never sent
lighting colours and effects (0x8071 / 0x8081 have no read-back)
G-key and M-key remaps, and a game mode beyond the key locks (no documented read-back)
PRO X TKL and G915 X (no product ids in any source read)
the K375s-style F-key swap 0x40A3 (needs the host-info feature; office keyboards)
selecting an onboard profile: read-only until Solaar's or libratbag's profile numbering is confirmed on a real keyboard
report rate over Bluetooth: it is the USB / Lightspeed polling rate; no source documents 0x8060 / 0x8061 over Bluetooth, so it is not looked up there
